binaries_from_source.name: minio
binaries_from_source._note: Single static binary. main_pkg is the repo ROOT '.' (main.go calls minio.Main(os.Args)). The canonical upstream recipe is Makefile target line 181: `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags kqueue -trimpath --ldflags "$(go run buildscripts/gen-ldflags.go)" -o minio .`. The version vars are declared in cmd/build-constants.go (defaults 'DEVELOPMENT.GOGET'); a plain `go build` without these -X flags reports DEVELOPMENT.GOGET, so the offline stage MUST stamp them explicitly here (the vendored --depth-1 tree has no git history for gen-ldflags.go to derive from). IMPORTANT: cmd.Version takes the DATE portion ONLY (2025-10-15T17-29-55Z, parsed via Go time layout 2006-01-02T15-04-05Z); the 'RELEASE.' prefix belongs only on cmd.ReleaseTag. CGO_ENABLED=0 + -tags kqueue yields a fully static ELF ('not a dynamic executable') ideal for the --network=none offline / non-root model. Verified live on <redacted: internal host>: go1.26.4, License GNU AGPLv3, embedded Console served at :9001 (WebUI banner + HTTP 200), /minio/health/live=200, runs as a non-root uid-999 minio user.
